_what: C-9 MIX v2 -- her DEFAULT Meteor (Matt, 2026-09-30: "I wanted the painted 2D impact with the 3D projectile ... I really do like the darker meteor of the painted projectile though, but I like the travel and shadow and fluidity of the burn of the 3D ... the flames left on the ground afterwards to be more like real smoldering cinders with a bit of small realistic burning areas"). drax.

build.fall: lane B's 3D rock and comet (meteor_fx.gd): its travel down the sun ray, its growing shadow, its fall light, RESTYLED toward lane A's painted head: the rock near-black (stone_lit 0.13/0.055/0.045, stone_dark 0.055/0.028/0.022), its facets cut by thin glowing seams (Voronoi on the mesh's object-space position, 10 cells; seam_w 0.075, core_w 0.022), its mesh x1.3 (ROCK_R, the hit point and the shadow unchanged), the corona set 0.6 x ROCK_R back up the path so the dark rock leads, the corona and trail in the fire palette with their hot core (heat offset 0.0)
build.impact: lane A's painted burst (meteor_a_fx.gd impact_only: the 50-piece burst flipbook, both seeds, its floor) at lane B's impact point and time; B's flash, its fire light on the characters and the camera shake kept; B's own burst mesh and its 18 scraps not drawn
build.burn: lane B's burn timing (BURN_S 3 s), restyled as SMOULDERING CINDERS: the ground term PaintedWorld.FX_GROUND_CINDERS (a charred patch with a sharp edge, ash lightening as it cools, glowing ember cracks that pulse and cool from yellow to dull red, ember specks; fading with B's fx_burn.w) and cinders_fx.gd (9 small flames 0.32-0.62 m tall flickering at scattered points, each born 0.35-0.8 s and dying 1.6-2.9 s after the impact, and 2 faint smoke wisps; one MultiMesh, one unshaded shader, one draw; warmed at load, nothing created at cast time)

queries.?meteor=mix1 (or ?meteor=mix): the first mix (A's fall, B's impact), its fall frames fetched as meteor_mix1.pck

rock_measure._: tools/rock_match.py: B's darkened rock + corona (default) against A's painted head (?meteor=mix1), the same fall frames paired by the fall clock, at the play camera on the phone page's look (Compatibility, --as-web, 1920x1080; godot/tools/probe_rock_match.gd at --fixed-fps 60). Nucleus = the near-black blob (L* < 22, seams closed, ink opened away); head = effect pixels within 130 px of it, banded dark L*<30 / mid / bright L*>80

before._: B's rock as first restyled (rock4: dark-red stone, no scale, corona heat -0.16)

rock_measure.residual: the dark nucleus now matches A's in area (1.03x) and the head's mean lightness is within 2.1 L*; the bands still differ: B's corona is cel-banded mid orange where A's flames are high-contrast (black ink outline + white-hot core), so B has 10 points fewer darks and 21 fewer brights. Closing that means outlining B's corona in ink, which is a restyle of the comet shader beyond the rock; not done

proof.impact_frames: meteor_mix2 ships A's impact_0, impact_1 and impact_floor only (236 frames, 234 unique; 2 pages 4096x2240, 5.10 MB lossless): every one of the 236 byte-identical, rect, tick and offset, to lane A's proven atlas (take/build/meteor_a_proof.json: worst 0.92/255); impact seeds, timing, anchors and px/m identical
proof.new_3d: the darkened rock and the cinders are new 3D, not baked: no flipbook proof applies; recorded by the rock measure above and the stills and film

budget._: delta against a matched control (the same chop cast, the Meteor off through MeteorFx.enabled and spell_fx.fx_off), 20 casts 6 s apart alternating, no screenshots in the timed window; fx time = MeteorFx (with the cinders) + A's burst node
budget.desktop_note: run 1 had two single warm frames over 33 ms (cast 3: 37.0 ms at 0.37 s after input; cast 17: 45.2 ms at 1.85 s) with draw 12.9 / 15.1 ms and fx script 0.1 ms: time outside the measured phases, not repeated in run 2 (max 20.9 ms)
budget.FINDING_first_visit: the first page load after this build (every MIX v2 shader new to this Mac's Metal compiler cache) warmed in 4.64 s against 1.48 s on the next load; the warm veil lifted at its 4.38 s cap with the warm-ups unfinished, so the first cast carried two shader stalls (357.9 ms and 225.3 ms). Every later load: the veil settled at 1.9 s, first cast max 27.2 ms. A first visit on a phone with a cold shader cache can do the same

packs._: her pack ships A's burst (meteor_mix2), not A's fall: the first mix's fall frames are meteor_mix1.pck's alone, A's full atlas meteor_a.pck's alone (fenced by each pack's file table)

fences: tools/build_web_painted.sh: all ok, including her default word mix2(fall=lane_b_dark,impact=lane_a,burn=cinders,ring=off,rock_shadow=on), ?meteor_shadow=0 -> rock_shadow=off, ?meteor=b, ?meteor=placeholder, the pack crossings; ?meteor=mix1 fetched meteor_mix1.pck in Chrome and ran its budget
film: Desktop review folder: 'C-9 sorceress Meteor MIX v2 - B fall darkened, A painted impact, cinders, no ring, rock shadow - play speed then quarter speed.mp4' (tools/film_mix.sh) and two stills (the rock against A's head over the same frames; the fall, burst and cinders at 6 per s)
